rows.role_title: 中央委員会議長 — Central Committee chair
rows.text: The party's diary of the 21st Congress records on the second day, the 23rd, at 17:59 that the presiding officer reported the absence of 宮本議長 ('執行議長から宮本議長欠席について報告').

rows.role_title: 中央委員会議長 — Central Committee chair
rows.text: It records on the final day, the 26th, at 10:26 the unanimous adoption of the partial amendment of the party rules ('党規約の一部改定を全員一致で採択').

locator.section: 第５日（２６日）最終日, 午前１０時２６分

rows.role_title: 名誉議長 — honorary chair of the Central Committee (another office; claims only)
rows.text: It records at 12:46 on the 26th the approval and introduction of the honorary chair, honorary Presidium members and advisers ('名誉議長、名誉幹部会委員・顧問の承認・紹介'), and at 13:32 the announcement of the new three principal officers ('新三役').

locator.section: 第５日（２６日）最終日, 午後０時４６分 and 午後１時３２分

rows.role_title: 幹部会委員長 — Executive Committee chair
rows.text: It records the closing address by 不破委員長 at 13:55 on the 26th, after the first plenum of the new Central Committee ('閉会あいさつ・不破委員長').

locator.section: 第５日（２６日）最終日, 午後１時５５分
